page.layout: One page, no printed text. Handwritten inscriptions, library stamps and shelf marks at the top left and bottom, and a digitiser's watermark at the bottom right.
page.notes: No printed text on this page. The handwritten inscription at the top right ("Fructus ... Bodus 1659" with the verse "(Quod) volunt fata / Hoa tollunt vota") is handwriting and is left out. The stamps (a boxed "8 / 7-B / 20" label and an octagonal stamp with "7 / 9 L / 3") and the shelf mark "8-4. B. 20" are library marks and are left out. The "Digitized by Google" line is the digitiser's mark and is left out.
